name: Jen Solis
residence: Cheyenne, Laramie County (moved there in August 2014; 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
occupation: Owner of Sol Solutions, providing bookkeeping, grant writing, and organizing services (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: Ballotpedia records that Jen Solis was born in Bangor, Maine. In her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire she wrote that Wyoming had been home since 1996, when she arrived at 18 after graduating from high school, first lived in Teton County, and moved to Cheyenne in August 2014. She said she would be 46 on Election Day 2024.

She wrote that her nonprofit career began about 25 years earlier as program director for the Latino Resource Center (later part of One-22 in Teton County), where she did grant writing, program development, and financial management; that she later did bookkeeping for small-business clients from home; that in 2017 she returned to nonprofit work as development director for Habitat for Humanity in Laramie County; and that in 2022 she grew her business, Sol Solutions, helping small businesses, nonprofits, and families with bookkeeping, grant writing, and organizing. Earlier research on this Profile also noted affiliations with the Wyoming Civic Engagement Network and the Wyoming Independent Citizens Coalition (Ballotpedia).
